facts.text: The first prototype of Atari’s coin‑operated Pong, the first successful video game, debuted in Sunnyvale in August 1972 at Andy Capp’s Tavern, now Rooster T.
Shockley Semiconductor Laboratory opened in Sunnyvale in 1956, launching the city’s long‑standing role in semiconductor and integrated‑circuit innovation.
NVIDIA, founded in 1993 by Jen‑Hsun Huang, Chris Malachowsky and Curtis Priem, began its groundbreaking work in Sunnyvale, shaping gaming, AI and autonomous‑vehicle technology.
Before becoming Sunnyvale, the area was part of Rancho Posolmi, a land grant named after an Ohlone village that once stood nearby.
In 1897, Walter Everett Crossman bought 200 acres of orchard land and organized the town, naming it Encinal before it later became Sunnyvale.
Sunnyvale earned the title of the safest city in 2018, a distinction it has held for three consecutive years.
